WASM Agent ABI Reference ​

The contract between a Synapse-compiled agent (my_agent.wasm) and the supervisor (Prefrontal, or any layer-3 host) that loads and runs it. Synapse guarantees compatibility with this ABI across minor (0.x.y) versions; breaking changes require a major version bump.

ABI version ​

Current: 1

Each WASM image MUST export a function:

synapse_abi_version() -> i32

returning the integer 1. Supervisors reject images whose returned version differs from the supported range.

Memory model ​

The WASM module owns a linear memory. All strings are passed as (ptr: i32, len: i32) pointing into that memory. Strings are always UTF-8.

The host pre-allocates a stream response buffer (default 64 KiB, configurable per agent) per call to stream_run. The agent writes chunks of AgentStreamEvent (CBOR or JSON, see §5) into this buffer; the host polls and forwards.

Exports (agent → host) ​

These are the functions every Synapse agent MUST export.

agent_card ​

agent_card(out_ptr: i32) -> i32

Writes an AgentCard JSON document into linear memory at out_ptr. Returns the byte length written. Returns -1 on error.

json
{
  "name": "weather-agent",
  "description": "Looks up weather forecasts.",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "skills": [
    {"id": "get_weather", "description": "...", "input_schema": {...}}
  ],
  "default_input_modes": ["text/plain"],
  "default_output_modes": ["text/plain"]
}

Conforms to the v1.0 A2A AgentCard schema https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/#agent-card.

stream_run ​

stream_run(
  input_ptr: i32,           // JSON encoded AgentInput
  input_len: i32,
  out_handle_ptr: i32       // host writes a u32 stream handle here
) -> i32                     // 0 on success, negative on error

Begins a streaming execution. The agent writes a sequence of AgentStreamEvents into the per-handle response buffer. The host drains the buffer until the agent writes a terminal Final/Error event, then closes the stream handle.

cancel_run ​

cancel_run(handle: u32) -> i32

Asks the agent to abort the stream identified by handle. The agent SHOULD emit a final Error { error: AgentError::Interrupted } event and close its end of the buffer.

query_task ​

query_task(
  task_id_ptr: i32,
  task_id_len: i32,
  out_ptr: i32
) -> i32  // returns length of `Task` JSON written to out_ptr

Returns the current A2A Task state for the given task_id, or -1 if the task is unknown.

subscribe_task ​

subscribe_task(
  task_id_ptr: i32,
  task_id_len: i32,
  out_handle_ptr: i32      // host writes a u32 stream handle here
) -> i32

Like stream_run but for an existing task. Returns a stream handle that yields StatusUpdateEvent / ArtifactUpdateEvents.

Imports (host → agent) ​

The host MUST provide the following imports.

wasi:http/outgoing-handler (and friends) ​

Standard WASI HTTP for outbound HTTPS calls. Used by the agent to reach LLM providers. See https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-http.

synapse:host/get_config ​

get_config(out_ptr: i32, out_cap: i32) -> i32  // returns length written

Returns the agent's runtime configuration as a JSON document:

json
{
  "llm_base_url": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
  "llm_api_key":  "sk-...",
  "llm_model":    "gpt-4o",
  "llm_extra":    { "organization": "..." },
  "a2a_peers": [
    {"name": "router", "url": "https://router.example.com"}
  ]
}

The agent calls this once at startup (and re-reads after every cancel_run to pick up rotation). The host controls freshness.

synapse:host/a2a_call ​

a2a_call(
  peer_name_ptr: i32, peer_name_len: i32,
  msg_ptr: i32, msg_len: i32,
  out_ptr: i32, out_cap: i32,
  out_len_ptr: i32
) -> i32  // status code: 0 ok, negative on error

Sends an A2A SendMessageRequest to the named peer (which must appear in a2a_peers config). The host performs the actual HTTP call with native a2a-rs client SDK, since WASM cannot drive reqwest. Returns the SendMessageResponse JSON in out_ptr and the length in out_len_ptr.

This is a synchronous call from the agent's perspective. For long peers the agent SHOULD dispatch it on a tokio::spawn and await its result.

Event payload format ​

Events written by the agent into the stream response buffer use the same AgentStreamEvent schema as the in-process Synapse streaming API:

json
{
  "event": "TokenDelta",
  "agent": "weather-agent",
  "delta": "The current"
}
json
{
  "event": "ToolStart",
  "agent": "weather-agent",
  "name": "get_weather",
  "args": "{\"city\":\"SF\"}"
}
json
{
  "event": "Final",
  "agent": "weather-agent",
  "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "..."}]}
}

See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-30-streaming-design.md §4.2 for the full variant list. The wire encoding is one JSON object per event, newline-delimited (NDJSON) so a partial write at the end of the buffer can be retried on the next poll cycle.

Stability policy ​

  • Within a single abi_version: the host MUST accept any agent that exports the same set of symbols with the same signatures.
  • Across abi_version: the host rejects agents with a different version. We provide synapse migrate <old.wasm> <new.wasm> (planned, not yet implemented) to upgrade agents in place.
  • Deprecated symbols: when an export is removed, the host continues to recognize and call the deprecated symbol during a deprecation window of one minor Synapse version, then stops.
